verdict.rationale: Alma's own pages describe it as combining expert attorneys with a technology-enabled system. They say every case is led by a dedicated attorney, backed by case intelligence from hundreds of prior filings and a system that flags risk early. That is only a glancing account of the human-plus-technology split: AI is never named, and no page says which drafting or review steps are automated and which an attorney checks. Missing for 10: an explicit statement of AI use in petition drafting and review, a breakdown of automated versus attorney-reviewed steps, and independent corroboration.
